author: Bobby Grayson
description: Caddy block lives in ~/code/blog/Caddyfile; mount is /opt/deciduous-site:/srv/deciduous:ro in ~/code/blog/docker-compose.yml. The site copy on the host dates from May 13, so a full docs/ rsync would change other pages too; only proof-map/ was pushed.
title: deciduous.dev is a static site: Caddy in the blog repo's compose serves /opt/deciduous-site (a copy of this repo's docs/) at deciduous.dev; deploy is rsync over the hetzner SSH alias. 'deciduous lean import' now accepts the proof guide URL and reads the embedded blueprint-data script.
